name: wovenflow
description: Wovenflow plugin self-tests. Dogfoods the testflow extractor: tests live in tests/*.spec.md as JavaScript fences, extracted to out/spec-tests/ by extract.mjs at pretest, then run with node --test.

scripts.pretest: node plugins/wovenflow/skills/testflow/extract.mjs 'tests/*.spec.md' out/spec-tests/ --lang javascript && { [ "$(ls -A out/spec-tests/ 2>/dev/null)" ] || { echo 'extractor produced no files'; exit 1; }; }
